appointment_history.sql: CREATE TABLE "appointment_history" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "appointment_id" integer not null, "old_values" text not null, "new_values" text not null, "reason" varchar not null, "changed_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("appointment_id") references "appointments"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("changed_by") references "users"("id"))

appointments.sql: CREATE TABLE "appointments" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "appointment_code" varchar not null, "patient_id" integer not null, "doctor_id" integer not null, "doctor_schedule_id" integer, "created_by" integer, "appointment_date" date not null, "start_time" time not null, "end_time" time not null, "status" varchar not null default 'PENDING', "reason" text not null, "patient_note" text, "cancel_reason" text, "checked_in_at" datetime, "cancelled_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "branch_id" integer not null default '1', "idempotency_key" varchar, foreign key("patient_id") references "patients"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("doctor_schedule_id") references "doctor_schedules"("id") on delete set null, foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id") on delete set null)

audit_logs.sql: CREATE TABLE "audit_logs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer, "action" varchar not null, "subject_type" varchar, "subject_id" integer, "old_values" text, "new_values" text, "ip_address" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "branch_id" integer, "request_id" varchar, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null)

branch_user.sql: CREATE TABLE "branch_user" ("branch_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, primary key ("branch_id", "user_id"))

branches.sql: CREATE TABLE "branches" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "code" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "address" varchar, "phone" varchar, "timezone" varchar not null default 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', "opening_hours" varchar, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

cache.sql: CREATE TABLE "cache" ("key" varchar not null, "value" text not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

cache_locks.sql: CREATE TABLE "cache_locks" ("key" varchar not null, "owner" varchar not null, "expiration" integer not null, primary key ("key"))

device_measurements.sql: CREATE TABLE "device_measurements" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "visit_id" integer not null, "device_code" varchar not null, "measurement_type" varchar not null, "value" numeric not null, "unit" varchar not null, "measured_at" datetime not null, "status" varchar not null default 'RECEIVED', "verified_by" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("visit_id") references "visits"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("verified_by") references "users"("id"))

diagnostic_results.sql: CREATE TABLE "diagnostic_results" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "service_order_item_id" integer not null, "value_text" text not null, "unit" varchar, "status" varchar not null default 'RECEIVED', "source" varchar not null default 'MANUAL', "attachment_path" varchar, "verified_at" datetime, "verified_by" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("service_order_item_id") references "service_order_items"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("verified_by") references "users"("id"))

dispensation_items.sql: CREATE TABLE "dispensation_items" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "dispensation_id" integer not null, "prescription_item_id" integer not null, "batch_id" integer not null, "quantity" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("dispensation_id") references "dispensations"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("prescription_item_id") references "prescription_items"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("batch_id") references "medicine_batches"("id") on delete restrict)

dispensations.sql: CREATE TABLE "dispensations" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "prescription_id" integer not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "status" varchar not null, "idempotency_key" varchar not null, "dispensed_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("prescription_id") references "prescriptions"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("dispensed_by") references "users"("id"))

doctor_schedules.sql: CREATE TABLE "doctor_schedules" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "doctor_id" integer not null, "work_date" date not null, "start_time" time not null, "end_time" time not null, "slot_minutes" integer not null default '30', "is_open" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "branch_id" integer not null default '1', "capacity" integer not null default '1', foreign key("doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete cascade)

doctor_specialty.sql: CREATE TABLE "doctor_specialty" ("doctor_id" integer not null, "specialty_id" integer not null, foreign key("doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("specialty_id") references "specialties"("id") on delete restrict, primary key ("doctor_id", "specialty_id"))

doctor_time_off.sql: CREATE TABLE "doctor_time_off" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "doctor_id" integer not null, "starts_at" datetime not null, "ends_at" datetime not null, "reason" varchar not null, "created_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id"))

doctors.sql: CREATE TABLE "doctors" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer not null, "specialty_id" integer not null, "doctor_code" varchar not null, "license_number" varchar not null, "qualification" varchar, "room" varchar, "bio" text, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("specialty_id") references "specialties"("id") on delete restrict)

failed_jobs.sql: CREATE TABLE "failed_jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "uuid" varchar not null, "connection" text not null, "queue" text not null, "payload" text not null, "exception" text not null, "failed_at" datetime not null default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

follow_up_plans.sql: CREATE TABLE "follow_up_plans" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "visit_id" integer not null, "suggested_from" date not null, "suggested_to" date not null, "reason" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'PROPOSED', "appointment_id" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("visit_id") references "visits"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("appointment_id") references "appointments"("id") on delete restrict)

goods_receipts.sql: CREATE TABLE "goods_receipts" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "batch_id" integer not null, "quantity" integer not null, "reference" varchar not null, "created_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("batch_id") references "medicine_batches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id"))

integration_messages.sql: CREATE TABLE "integration_messages" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "integration_system_id" integer not null, "external_message_id" varchar not null, "payload_hash" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'RECEIVED', "error_code" varchar, "resource_id" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("integration_system_id") references "integration_systems"("id") on delete restrict)

integration_systems.sql: CREATE TABLE "integration_systems" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "code" varchar not null, "type" varchar not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "token_hash" varchar not null, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict)

invoice_items.sql: CREATE TABLE "invoice_items" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "invoice_id" integer not null, "service_id" integer, "description" varchar not null, "quantity" integer not null default '1', "unit_price" numeric not null, "amount" numeric not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "source_type" varchar, "source_id" integer, foreign key("invoice_id") references "invoices"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("service_id") references "services"("id") on delete set null)

invoices.sql: CREATE TABLE invoices (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, appointment_id BIGINT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, issued_by INTEGER DEFAULT NULL, invoice_code VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, subtotal NUMERIC(10, 0) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, discount NUMERIC(10, 0) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, total NUMERIC(10, 0) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, status VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT 'UNPAID' NOT NULL, issued_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, paid_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, "visit_id" integer, "branch_id" integer not null default '1', FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments (id) ON UPDATE NO ACTION NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, FOREIGN KEY (issued_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE SET NULL NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE)

job_batches.sql: CREATE TABLE "job_batches" ("id" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "total_jobs" integer not null, "pending_jobs" integer not null, "failed_jobs" integer not null, "failed_job_ids" text not null, "options" text, "cancelled_at" integer, "created_at" integer not null, "finished_at" integer, primary key ("id"))

jobs.sql: CREATE TABLE "jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "queue" varchar not null, "payload" text not null, "attempts" integer not null, "reserved_at" integer, "available_at" integer not null, "created_at" integer not null)

medical_record_revisions.sql: CREATE TABLE "medical_record_revisions" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "medical_record_id" integer not null, "version" integer not null, "snapshot" text not null, "reason" varchar not null, "updated_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("medical_record_id") references "medical_records"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("updated_by") references "users"("id"))

medical_records.sql: CREATE TABLE medical_records (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, appointment_id BIGINT UNSIGNED DEFAULT NULL, doctor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, symptoms CLOB DEFAULT NULL, diagnosis CLOB NOT NULL, conclusion CLOB DEFAULT NULL, prescription CLOB DEFAULT NULL, notes CLOB DEFAULT NULL, published_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT NULL, "visit_id" integer, "findings" text, "status" varchar not null default 'DRAFT', "version" integer not null default '1', "signed_at" datetime, "signed_by" integer, FOREIGN KEY (appointment_id) REFERENCES appointments (id) ON UPDATE NO ACTION NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE, FOREIGN KEY (doctor_id) REFERENCES doctors (id) ON UPDATE NO ACTION NOT DEFERRABLE INITIALLY IMMEDIATE)

medicine_batches.sql: CREATE TABLE "medicine_batches" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "medicine_id" integer not null, "lot_number" varchar not null, "expiry_date" date not null, "available_qty" integer not null default '0', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("medicine_id") references "medicines"("id") on delete restrict)

medicines.sql: CREATE TABLE "medicines" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "code" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "unit" varchar not null, "strength" varchar, "price" numeric not null default '0', "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE "migrations" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "migration" varchar not null, "batch" integer not null)

notification_jobs.sql: CREATE TABLE "notification_jobs" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "appointment_id" integer, "event_key" varchar not null, "recipient" varchar not null, "template" varchar not null, "body" text not null, "status" varchar not null default 'PENDING', "retry_count" integer not null default '0', "scheduled_at" datetime not null, "sent_at" datetime, "error_code" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("appointment_id") references "appointments"("id") on delete restrict)

password_reset_tokens.sql: CREATE TABLE "password_reset_tokens" ("email" varchar not null, "token" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, primary key ("email"))

patients.sql: CREATE TABLE "patients" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer, "patient_code" varchar not null, "full_name" varchar not null, "birth_date" date, "gender" varchar, "phone" varchar, "email" varchar, "address" varchar, "blood_type" varchar, "insurance_number" varchar, "allergies" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "registered_branch_id" integer, "medical_history" text, "emergency_contact" varchar, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "email_enabled" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "auto_booking_consented_at" datetime, "auto_booking_expires_at" datetime, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete set null)

payments.sql: CREATE TABLE "payments" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "invoice_id" integer not null, "received_by" integer, "amount" numeric not null, "method" varchar not null, "reference" varchar, "paid_at" datetime not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "status" varchar not null default 'SUCCEEDED', "idempotency_key" varchar, foreign key("invoice_id") references "invoices"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("received_by") references "users"("id") on delete set null)

payroll_entries.sql: CREATE TABLE "payroll_entries" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer not null, "pay_month" date not null, "employee_name" varchar not null, "role_name" varchar not null, "pay_basis" varchar not null, "unit_rate" numeric not null, "worked_minutes" integer not null default '0', "worked_shifts" integer not null default '0', "base_amount" numeric not null, "allowance" numeric not null default '0', "bonus" numeric not null default '0', "deduction" numeric not null default '0', "net_amount" numeric not null, "source_shifts" text not null, "calculated_at" datetime not null, "adjustment_reason" varchar, "note" varchar, "status" varchar not null default 'UNPAID', "paid_by" integer, "paid_at" datetime, "payment_reference" varchar, "version" integer not null default '1', "created_by" integer not null, "updated_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("paid_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("updated_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict)

prescription_items.sql: CREATE TABLE "prescription_items" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "prescription_id" integer not null, "medicine_id" integer not null, "dosage" varchar not null, "route" varchar not null, "frequency" varchar not null, "duration_days" integer not null, "quantity" integer not null, "instructions" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("prescription_id") references "prescriptions"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("medicine_id") references "medicines"("id") on delete restrict)

prescriptions.sql: CREATE TABLE "prescriptions" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "visit_id" integer not null, "doctor_id" integer not null, "status" varchar not null default 'DRAFT', "bill_at_clinic" tinyint(1) not null default '0', "signed_at" datetime, "signed_by" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("visit_id") references "visits"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("signed_by") references "users"("id"))

refunds.sql: CREATE TABLE "refunds" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "payment_id" integer not null, "amount" numeric not null, "reason" varchar not null, "idempotency_key" varchar not null, "approved_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("payment_id") references "payments"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("approved_by") references "users"("id"))

roles.sql: CREATE TABLE "roles" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "code" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

salary_profiles.sql: CREATE TABLE "salary_profiles" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer not null, "pay_basis" varchar not null, "unit_rate" numeric not null, "version" integer not null default '1', "updated_by" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("updated_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict)

service_order_items.sql: CREATE TABLE "service_order_items" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "service_order_id" integer not null, "service_id" integer not null, "external_order_code" varchar not null, "status" varchar not null default 'ORDERED', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("service_order_id") references "service_orders"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("service_id") references "services"("id") on delete restrict)

service_orders.sql: CREATE TABLE "service_orders" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "visit_id" integer not null, "doctor_id" integer not null, "status" varchar not null default 'ORDERED', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("visit_id") references "visits"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict)

services.sql: CREATE TABLE "services" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "code" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "description" text, "price" numeric not null, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

sessions.sql: CREATE TABLE "sessions" ("id" varchar not null, "user_id" integer, "ip_address" varchar, "user_agent" text, "payload" text not null, "last_activity" integer not null, primary key ("id"))

shift_transfer_requests.sql: CREATE TABLE "shift_transfer_requests" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "doctor_schedule_id" integer not null, "sender_doctor_id" integer not null, "receiver_doctor_id" integer not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "work_date" date not null, "start_time" time not null, "end_time" time not null, "status" varchar not null default 'PENDING', "pending_key" integer, "note" varchar not null, "responded_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("doctor_schedule_id") references "doctor_schedules"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("sender_doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("receiver_doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict)

specialties.sql: CREATE TABLE "specialties" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "code" varchar not null, "name" varchar not null, "description" text, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime)

staff_schedule_requests.sql: CREATE TABLE "staff_schedule_requests" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "role_code" varchar not null, "work_date" date not null, "start_time" time not null, "end_time" time not null, "status" varchar not null default 'WAITING', "active_key" varchar, "note" varchar, "decision_note" varchar, "processed_by" integer, "processed_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("processed_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict)

staff_work_shifts.sql: CREATE TABLE "staff_work_shifts" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "request_id" integer not null, "user_id" integer not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "role_code" varchar not null, "work_date" date not null, "start_time" time not null, "end_time" time not null, "status" varchar not null default 'DRAFT', "note" varchar, "created_by" integer not null, "published_by" integer, "published_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("request_id") references "staff_schedule_requests"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("created_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("published_by") references "users"("id") on delete restrict)

stock_movements.sql: CREATE TABLE "stock_movements" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "batch_id" integer not null, "quantity_delta" integer not null, "type" varchar not null, "reference_type" varchar not null, "reference_id" integer not null, "reason" varchar, "actor_id" integer not null, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("batch_id") references "medicine_batches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("actor_id") references "users"("id"))

user_permissions.sql: CREATE TABLE "user_permissions" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "user_id" integer not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "permission_code" varchar not null, "granted_by" integer, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("user_id") references "users"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("granted_by") references "users"("id") on delete set null)

users.sql: CREATE TABLE "users" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "role_id" integer not null, "name" varchar not null, "email" varchar not null, "phone" varchar, "email_verified_at" datetime, "password" varchar not null, "is_active" tinyint(1) not null default '1', "remember_token" varchar, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, "status" varchar not null default 'ACTIVE', foreign key("role_id") references "roles"("id") on delete restrict)

visit_services.sql: CREATE TABLE "visit_services" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "medical_record_id" integer not null, "service_id" integer not null, "quantity" integer not null default '1', "unit_price" numeric not null, "note" text, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("medical_record_id") references "medical_records"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("service_id") references "services"("id") on delete restrict)

visits.sql: CREATE TABLE "visits" ("id" integer primary key autoincrement not null, "visit_code" varchar not null, "appointment_id" integer, "patient_id" integer not null, "doctor_id" integer not null, "branch_id" integer not null, "status" varchar not null default 'WAITING', "reason" text not null, "checked_in_at" datetime not null, "started_at" datetime, "completed_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("appointment_id") references "appointments"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("patient_id") references "patients"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("doctor_id") references "doctors"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("branch_id") references "branches"("id") on delete restrict)
